description: Angular component for configuring data sources in a widget, including form handling, validation, and interaction with widget configuration.

classes.name: DatasourceComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for widget data source configuration.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touched callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group based on the disabled state.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given Datasource object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: isDataKeysOptional
methods.description: Determines if data keys are optional based on datasource type and configuration.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators for form controls based on current datasource type and configuration.
